sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié kuài dào le, fàngxué yǐhòu, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì yīqǐ huíjiā.
sentences.english: Teacher's Day was approaching, and after school, Xiaoming and Lili walked home together.

sentences.pinyin: Lùshang, Xiǎomíng duì Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng sòng lǎoshī yī fèn lǐwù, nǐ juéde sòng shénme hǎo?"
sentences.english: On the way, Xiaoming said to Lili, "I want to give our teacher a gift. What do you think would be good?"

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiǎngle xiǎng, shuō: "Wǒ tīngshuō lǎoshī zuì xǐhuan huā. Nǐ kàn, lùbiān yǒu hěn duō yěhuā, wǒmen zhāi yīxiē ba."
sentences.english: Lili thought for a moment and said, "I heard that teacher likes flowers the most. Look, there are many wildflowers by the roadside, let's pick some."

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng gāoxìng de shuō: "Hǎo zhǔyi! Wǒ hái yào zuò yī zhāng kǎpiàn, xiě shang 'Lǎoshī xièxie nín'."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said happily, "Good idea! I also want to make a card and write 'Thank you, Teacher' on it."

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiàozhe shuō: "Tài hǎo le! Wǒ huì huàhuà, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ huà jǐ duǒ xiǎohuā, ràng kǎpiàn gèng piàoliang."
sentences.english: Lili smiled and said, "Great! I know how to draw, so I can help you draw a few little flowers to make the card even prettier."

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yībiān zǒu, yībiān zhāi huā, hěn kuài jiù zhāile yī dà bǎ.
sentences.english: As they walked, they picked flowers, and soon they had gathered a large bunch.

sentences.pinyin: Huí dào jiā yǐhòu, liǎng gè rén kāishǐ zuò kǎpiàn.
sentences.english: After arriving home, the two of them started making the card.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiān zài kǎpiàn shang huàle jǐ duǒ xiǎohuā, hái xiě shangle "Jiàoshījié kuàilè".
sentences.english: First, Lili drew a few little flowers on the card and also wrote "Happy Teacher's Day".

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xiǎng zài kǎpiàn shang xiě "Lǎoshī xièxie nín" wǔ gè zì, kěshì tā xiěle liǎng cì, dōu juéde zì bù tài hǎokàn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming wanted to write the five characters "Thank you, Teacher" on the card, but he wrote it twice and felt the handwriting didn't look very nice both times.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì duì tā shuō: "Bié zhāojí, nǐ duō liànxí jǐ cì, yīdìng huì xiě de yuè lái yuè hǎo."
sentences.english: Lili said to him, "Don't worry, practice a few more times and you will definitely write better and better."

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng tīngle Lìlì de huà, yòu rènzhēn de liànle hěn duō cì.
sentences.english: Listening to Lili's words, Xiaoming earnestly practiced many more times.

sentences.pinyin: Xiě wán yǐhòu, tā kànle kàn, gāoxìng de shuō: "Zhè cì xiě de yòu zhěngqí yòu piàoliang!"
sentences.english: After finishing, he looked at it and said happily, "This time it is written both neatly and beautifully!"

sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié nà tiān zǎoshang, tāmen hěn zǎo jiù dào le xuéxiào, bǎ yěhuā hé kǎpiàn yīqǐ sòng gěi le lǎoshī.
sentences.english: On the morning of Teacher's Day, they arrived at school very early and presented the wildflowers and the card together to their teacher.
The teacher looked at the card and was deeply moved.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàozhe shuō: "Xièxie nǐmen! Nǐmen zhēn yòngxīn, zhè shì wǒ shōudào de zuì hǎo de lǐwù!"
sentences.english: She smiled and said, "Thank you! You are so thoughtful; this is the best gift I have received!"

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì tīngle, dōu gāoxìng de xiào le.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili smiled happily upon hearing this.

sentences.pinyin: Huíjiā de lùshang, tāmen yībiān zǒu yībiān shuō, juéde jīntiān zhēn shì kuàilè de yī tiān.
sentences.english: On the way home, they chatted as they walked, feeling that today was truly a happy day.
